For Super Speciality posts: MD/MS/DNB in the related broad speciality, along with DM/M.Ch/DNB in the concerned super speciality.

salary_details.details: Selected Senior Residents will be placed in Pay Matrix Level-11, with a minimum basic pay of Rs. 67,700/-, plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) admissible to medical personnel, as per the recommendations of the 7th Central Pay Commission. | As per the terms and conditions of the notification, appointees on this ad-hoc basis are not entitled to benefits such as Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, or Seniority/Promotion available to regular Government servants.

selection_process: Selection is based on a personal interview. However
if the number of candidates who apply is large
a written examination consisting of MCQs in the concerned subject will be conducted first
and shortlisted candidates from this exam will then appear for the interview. The list of selected candidates will be uploaded on the official institute website
and candidates are advised to check it regularly for updates.
how_to_apply: This recruitment does not use an online application portal. Interested and eligible candidates must appear in person as a walk-in candidate, following these steps:
Download and fill the prescribed bio-data/application proforma (Annexure A) from the official website, www.aiimsrbl.edu.in.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials supporting qualification, experience, date of birth, and category, along with a self-attested latest photograph.

If currently employed in a Government/Semi-Government/Corporate body or undertaking of the Central or State Government, obtain a "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer - without this, candidates may not be permitted to appear for the interview.
Report at AIIMS, Raebareli by 10:00 AM on the interview date.
Attend document verification and screening of applications between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM.
Appear for the interview from 03:00 PM onwards, carrying all original certificates/testimonials for verification.
Note: Candidates are not entitled to any TA/DA for attending the interview or joining the Institute.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: AIIMS Raebareli has officially released Notice No. AIIMS/RBL/REC/SR/2026/480 dated 27 August 2026 for the recruitment of 108 Senior Residents across 35 departments on an ad-hoc basis. The notification includes complete details on department-wise and category-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, medical registration requirements, age limit, salary, reservation, selection process, walk-in interview schedule, document verification and terms and conditions of appointment. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification carefully before appearing for the interview. The official notification is available on the AIIMS Raebareli website. Download AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Official Website

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 108 Senior Resident vacancies are notified across 35 departments, with a category-wise break-up as shown below. If no applicant is available or turns up under the EWS category, that EWS post will be filled by an Unreserved (UR) candidate. 4% horizontal reservation applies for PwD candidates as per Government of India rules. OBC (NCL) candidates must produce a certificate of the current financial year at the time of reporting. The EWS income & asset certificate must be issued between 01.04.2025 and the reporting date, based on income for financial year 2024-25, valid for financial year 2025-26. The above posts are provisional and may be varied at the discretion of the competent authority. All selected candidates will be posted at AIIMS, Rae Bareli, Uttar Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: For the post of Senior Resident (Non-Academic), candidates must fulfil the following essential qualifications: A medical qualification included in the first or second schedule, or Part II of the third schedule, of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (candidates with Part II third-schedule qualifications must also satisfy the conditions in Section 13(3) of the Act). Registration with the Central or State Medical Council. For Broad Speciality posts: MD/MS/DNB in the concerned speciality, or an equivalent qualification. For Super Speciality posts: MD/MS/DNB in the related broad speciality, along with DM/M.Ch/DNB in the concerned super speciality.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the post of Senior Resident is 45 years, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Salary / Pay Scale 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Senior Residents will be placed in Pay Matrix Level-11, with a minimum basic pay of Rs. 67,700/-, plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) admissible to medical personnel, as per the recommendations of the 7th Central Pay Commission. As per the terms and conditions of the notification, appointees on this ad-hoc basis are not entitled to benefits such as Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, or Seniority/Promotion available to regular Government servants.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a personal interview. However, if the number of candidates who apply is large, a written examination consisting of MCQs in the concerned subject will be conducted first, and shortlisted candidates from this exam will then appear for the interview. The list of selected candidates will be uploaded on the official institute website, and candidates are advised to check it regularly for updates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This recruitment does not use an online application portal. Interested and eligible candidates must appear in person as a walk-in candidate, following these steps: Download and fill the prescribed bio-data/application proforma (Annexure A) from the official website, www.aiimsrbl.edu.in. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials supporting qualification, experience, date of birth, and category, along with a self-attested latest photograph. If currently employed in a Government/Semi-Government/Corporate body or undertaking of the Central or State Government, obtain a "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer - without this, candidates may not be permitted to appear for the interview. Report at AIIMS, Raebareli by 10:00 AM on the interview date. Attend document verification and screening of applications between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM. Appear for the interview from 03:00 PM onwards, carrying all original certificates/testimonials for verification. Note: Candidates are not entitled to any TA/DA for attending the interview or joining the Institute.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Interview Schedule and Venue
content_sections.text: Reporting venue: LT Ground, Medical College Building, AIIMS Raebareli, Munshiganj, Raebareli - 229405, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a rolling advertisement issued by All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli, inviting eligible doctors for a walk-in interview to fill 108 Senior Resident posts across 35 departments, on an ad-hoc basis for six months.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 108 Senior Resident vacancies are notified, spread across 35 departments and reservation categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: A separate "last date" is not specified in the notification, as this is a walk-in interview. Candidates submit their application and documents in person at the time of document verification on 08.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a recognised medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act 1956, registration with the Central/State Medical Council, and MD/MS/DNB in the relevant speciality (or DM/M.Ch/DNB for super-speciality posts).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application. Candidates must appear as walk-in candidates with the filled Annexure A bio-data form and self-attested documents at AIIMS Raebareli on the interview date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview. If applications are numerous, a written MCQ-based exam is held first, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in Pay Matrix Level-11 with a minimum pay of Rs. 67,700/- plus NPA, as per 7th CPC recommendations.
